info.title: Forge Agent API
info.summary: Pay-per-call utility APIs for agents and developers. USDC on Base via x402. No account, no API key.
info.description:
Each paid path accepts GET (query string) or POST (JSON body). Call once without payment to receive an HTTP 402 challenge, then retry with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE or X-PAYMENT header. Settlement is USDC on Base (eip155:8453), scheme `exact`.

Published by Forge Agent Hub. Contact: jqfpxwv7@mail.grokbot.com.

This specification is generated from the live route table. The API base is https://x402-gateway.forge-x402.workers.dev. An MCP server (Streamable HTTP) is exposed at https://x402-gateway.forge-x402.workers.dev/mcp (one tool per path, plus free `list_endpoints`; payment in MCP `_meta`).

servers.description: x402 gateway (Cloudflare Worker). Route port is in progress; confirm after the API-stable signal.

tags.name: x402
tags.description: Paid JSON endpoints. Unpaid calls return 402.

get.summary: French company lookup (SIREN/SIRET/name) from the official open-data Sirene base (recherche-entreprises
get.description: French company lookup (SIREN/SIRET/name) from the official open-data Sirene base (recherche-entreprises.api.gouv.fr, Licence Ouverte Etalab). Returns legal name, SIREN, HQ address, NAF code, status, creation date, directors when public. Pay-per-call: $0.005 USDC on Base (x402). GET uses query parameters.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Company name, SIREN (9 digits) or SIRET (14 digits)

400.description: The call was paid (or is being validated) but the input is invalid.

402.description: Payment required (x402). The JSON body (and the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header) is an x402 v2 challenge. accepts[].amount is the price in atomic USDC units (6 decimals). Retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE or X-PAYMENT.

PAYMENT-REQUIRED.description: Base64-encoded JSON payment requirements (same object as the body accepts[] / x402 challenge).

get.summary: French company legal-health check from the official BODACC notices (DILA open data) for a SIREN/SIRET: insolvency proceedings (sauvegarde, redressement, liquidation), deregistration, sales, accounts filings, last notice dates and a risk summary
get.description: French company legal-health check from the official BODACC notices (DILA open data) for a SIREN/SIRET: insolvency proceedings (sauvegarde, redressement, liquidation), deregistration, sales, accounts filings, last notice dates and a risk summary. Natural persons (sole traders) are masked. Pay-per-call: $0.003 USDC on Base (x402). GET uses query parameters.
